issues.description: The template's Main.java instantiates Seal, Pig, and Goat using two-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the problem description and the solution expect single-argument constructors that take only the animal's name. This discrepancy can confuse students about the required constructor signatures for the animal classes and may lead them to implement incorrect constructors.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template Main.java with the problem specification and solution by using single-argument constructors that accept only the animal's name (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle")). Alternatively, if two-argument constructors are intended, update the problem statement, UML, and solution to document and implement the additional attribute so all artifacts agree.
